text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Maruzensky...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Time really flies when you're having fun, doesn't it?
I'm honestly kinda sad to see it end~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then... since we're already out,
let's make a little detour somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Going home straight away
feels kind of boring, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yay♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then can I decide where we go?
There's something I've been wanting to do for a while!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come along now, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Mhm, mhm, they're still going at it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to try this—
an amusement park in the evening!
Maruzensky's destination was an amusement park right before closing time, where many people were already packing up to head home.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With that after-five vibe going on, all the hyped-up
girls start gathering around this time, you know?♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With fewer crowds, it's easier to hang out,
and rumor has it you can enjoy lots of rides!
choice_data_list: It's almost closing time, are we gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "A-OK! That's your chance to show what you're made of, right, Trainer-kun?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "A-OK! That's your chance to show what you're made of, right, Trainer-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What kind of strategy do you think we should go with to enjoy this to the absolute fullest?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "By the way, for now, I kinda wanna ride the roller coaster~."
choice_data_list: Why not just ride the roller coaster over and over!
Keep riding without taking a break!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
W-What did you say~?!
Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Isn't that a totally groovy idea!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Going all-in on one thing is a luxurious way to spend time
that you can only enjoy at an hour like this♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They say the roller coaster here is one of the fastest in the country, so it's perfect for laps!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you didn't know?
Well, no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you're used to my driving,
you probably won't even think it's a big deal!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you're used to my driving,
you probably won't even think it's a big deal!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right, before I change my mind... wait, no,
we're wasting time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's-a-go-go☆

Afterward, we rode the roller coaster over and over,
and I definitely felt a tolerance for speed build up... but.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, are you okay? Can you stand?
Want your big sister to give you a piggyback ride?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, are you okay? Can you stand?
Want big sis to give you a piggyback ride?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"We went way too hard, didn't we~?
Let's rest on that bench over there before we head home."
—Together, the two of them quietly watched the amusement park as the crowds gradually thinned out.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, simple and easy to understand!
I like it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"How far we can make our rounds
might turn into a battle of endurance, but..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm dreaming big—I want to master every vehicle out there!
It's gonna be a rough road, but are you ready for it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that vibe is the best!
You totally get it, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that vibe is the best!
You totally get it, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And now, charge~☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, halfway conquered!
The final spurt starts here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Trainer-kun!
Let's get through this together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, do your best!
Let's get through this together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: If it's us, we can definitely do it!! Come on, let's make history~!

Afterward, swept up in Maruzensky's hype,
we sprinted across the park at full speed...
and somehow managed to ride every single attraction!
